LanguageData.Kiiro.StoryActiveDesc: Determines whether to enable the full faction interaction system, including mood effects, settlement abandonment, and special forces raids. It is only recommended to disable this if mod conflicts occur.\n\nWhen Kiiro Event Expansion is enabled, this option will also control whether various events can trigger. It is recommended to keep this enabled for the full experience.
LanguageData.Kiiro.SettlementAbandonDesc: Determines whether to enable the Kiiro settlement abandonment system. When enabled, Kiiro settlements will gradually disappear as hostility duration with their faction increases. Only recommended to disable in case of mod conflicts.
LanguageData.Kiiro.NightRaidThreatDesc: Determines whether to enable special forces raid events. Only recommended to disable in case of mod conflicts.
LanguageData.Kiiro.NonPlayerPoisonBottleDesc: Determines whether non-player Kiiro factions can use poison bottles.
LanguageData.Kiiro.RaceRestrictedApparelDesc: Determines whether the Kiiro race is restricted to wearing only specific apparel.\n\nExperimental feature. When disabled, Kiiro characters can wear any apparel. No responsibility is taken for potential conflicts or errors.
LanguageData.Kiiro.ShellaStoryTellerTexDesc: Determines whether to enable the Shella crossover storyteller outfit for Kiiro storyteller. Requires a game restart.
